projects.title: Independent IT & Hardware Support

Diagnosed issues involving storage, RAM, thermals, graphics, peripherals, and system performance.

projects.title: Heavy Vehicle Recognition System
projects.role: Final Year Project (FYP) — Machine Learning Research
projects.description: Developed a deep learning system to classify heavy vehicles into small, medium, and large categories based on side-view images. Built using a CNN architecture with ResNet50 as the backbone, trained and evaluated in TensorFlow and Python. The system processes real-world vehicle images captured from road-side angles and outputs accurate size classification to support traffic monitoring and road safety applications.

philosophy.title: 03. Technical Philosophy
philosophy.statement: Technology is more than writing code.
philosophy.statementDetail: Whether I'm building software or troubleshooting hardware, I focus on understanding the root problem, finding practical solutions, and making systems work reliably.

points.label: Understand first, solve second
points.detail: Before touching the code, hardware, or system, I first understand the problem, its symptoms, and its possible causes.

points.label: Solve the root problem
points.detail: I focus on identifying why something is failing rather than simply treating the symptoms.

points.label: Build and maintain reliable systems
points.detail: Whether it's a software application or a PC, I value solutions that are stable, maintainable, and reliable.

points.label: Keep learning across technology
points.detail: Software and hardware are constantly evolving. I continuously expand my technical knowledge to solve a wider range of problems.

beyondCoding.title: 04. Beyond The Code
beyondCoding.description: What shapes an engineer is not only what they build, but how they live. These pursuits keep the mindset sharp, grounded, and always evolving.

interests.title: TikTok Affiliate & Digital Marketing
interests.description: Started doing TikTok affiliate out of curiosity and ended up genuinely enjoying the content creation side of it. I like understanding what makes people click, buy, and come back. Its part creative, part data.

interests.title: Hardware & Laptop Repair
interests.description: I actually enjoy taking laptops apart and figuring out what is wrong with them. There is something satisfying about diagnosing a dead machine and bringing it back to life. Its like a puzzle every single time.

interests.title: Gaming & Strategy
interests.description: Gaming is just something I genuinely love. I am drawn to games that make you think, whether its outplaying someone or figuring out the best strategy on the fly. Its my go to way to unwind and have fun.

interests.title: Fitness & Gym
interests.description: Gym has become a big part of my routine. It keeps me grounded, clears my head, and honestly the discipline you build from showing up consistently carries into everything else in life.

interests.title: Technology & Continuous Learning
interests.description: Always poking around new tools, gadgets, and tech that catches my eye. Whether its a new AI app or some random piece of hardware, I am probably already looking into it. I genuinely enjoy learning new things, not because I have to, but because staying curious keeps things interesting.

interests.title: Sports
interests.description: Outside of screens I stay active through badminton and bowling. Badminton keeps me sharp and quick on my feet, while bowling is all about precision and consistency. Both sports teach patience, focus, and the drive to keep improving.

items.title: Growth Mindset
items.description: Every challenge is a learning opportunity. I approach problems with curiosity, and treat every feedback loop as a chance to improve.

items.title: Problem Solving
items.description: Breaking down complex technical issues into clear, practical solutions. I focus on understanding the root problem before deciding how to fix it.

items.title: Ownership
items.description: I take responsibility for the quality and reliability of the solutions I work on, whether it's software, hardware, or technical support.

items.title: Collaboration
